description.value: Hi Dozo Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in New Westminster offering a wide menu of sushi rolls, nigiri, sashimi, udon, teriyaki, and appetizers. The restaurant has indoor seating and caters to groups with party tray options. Online ordering is temporarily suspended, but in-store and phone orders are accepted.
